notes:
Summary: Valorium is a mid- to large-size defense integrator building an on-prem inference capability for classified and CUI workloads. They require a fully air-gapped Private deployment or a vendor-supplied appliance that can be physically sequestered. Key quote from CTO: "No model or inference output can egress the enclave — all telemetry goes to approved SIEM with customer-managed keys."

POC ask: 6-node GPU cluster (customer will provide data center rack + network), HSM integration (FIPS 140-2 or 140-3), STIG benching, SCAP scans, and SIEM/Syslog forwarder. Must demonstrate prefix/KV cache disabled by default for classified contexts and data labeling/redaction built into ingest pipeline.

Security/compliance notes: procurement expects vendor attestation for supply chain, SCA bill-of-materials, and optional third-party code review. They pushed strongly for SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, audit log retention 7 years, and ability to run with no internet egress.

Commercial: procurement prefers annual license + support. Suggested pricing model: reserved capacity + per-node support. Finance wants hardware vs software-only options on SOW.

Sales posture: technical sale led by AE + SE + Security PM. CSM assigned conditional on go-live.

Customer language/shorthand seen in notes: "air-gap required", "HSM first", "show STIG results", "no telemetry out", "must pass red-team before PROD".

Recommended Redwood actions: prepare air-gapped deployment checklist, ship pre-signed offline installer, draft SOW with both vendor-appliance and customer-GFE paths, schedule on-site security lab demo, and scope a focused evaluation that verifies no-evidence-of-exfil tests.
